{{Recipe}}

'''Yam and egg sauce''' is a dish eaten mostly as breakfast

== Ingredients ==
* [[Cookbook:Yam|Yam]]
* [[Cookbook:Tomato|Tomatoes]]
* Peppers
* [[Cookbook:Egg|Egg]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] 
* [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|Groundnut oil]]

== Equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|Frying pan]]
* Pot
* Cooking spoon
* Bowl
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]] 

== Procedure ==

# Peel and [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] the yam. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] yam in water until soft, then drain.
# Blend the tomatoes and peppers together. Whisk together with the egg and a pinch of salt.
# Cook the egg mixture in a hot pan with a little oil.
# Serve the eggs with the yam.
